shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -100

sed -n 1,120p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && grep -n -i -E 'navigation|table|aside|icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40 && echo ---- && cat src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && ls __agent_eval__ node_modules/@gravity-ui

sed -n 367,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && sed -n 452,475p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table 2>&1 | tail -15 && for p in navigation table; do echo "== $p"; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json');console.log(p.version);console.log('peers',JSON.stringify(p.peerDependencies))"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/dist/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null; done; ls node_modules/@tanstack 2>/dev/null

ls node_modules/@dnd-kit node_modules/@bem-react 2>&1; ls -d node_modules/lodash 2>&1; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120

grep -n -i -E 'ColumnReordering|columnOrder|useRowSelectionFixedHandler|styles\.css|withNestingStyles|getGroupTitle|TableSettings|stickyHeader|rowVirtualizer' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -40; echo ----; grep -n -A60 'Column reordering\|ColumnReorderingProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md | sed -n 1,120p

sed -n 555,630p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo "---- STYLES"; grep -n -i -B2 -A6 'styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md | head -40; echo "---- FIXED HANDLER"; grep -rn -A12 'useRowSelectionFixedHandler' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "---- TABLE PROPS"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "---- ICONS"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i -E '^(House|Persons|Person|ShoppingCart|Cart|Gear|Bag|Box|ListCheck|Receipt|CircleDollar|Sun|Moon|ArrowsRotate|Magnifier|TrashBin)\.' ; echo "---- ASIDE"; sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md

echo "---- ASIDE PROPS"; grep -n -A4 -E '^\| ?(logo|menuItems|renderContent|headerDecoration|compact|onChangeCompact|hideCollapseButton|subheaderItems|multipleTooltip|renderFooter|className) ' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -60; echo "---- MENUITEM TYPE"; grep -n -B2 -A30 'export interface MenuItem\b\|export type MenuItem\b\|export interface AsideHeaderItem\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/ | head; echo "---- LOGO"; grep -rn -A12 'export interface LogoProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "---- FIXED HANDLER PARAMS"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts; echo "---- LABEL"; grep -n -E 'theme|size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head; echo "---- TREE CELL"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/TreeExpandableCell/TreeExpandableCell.d.ts

grep -rn -A25 'export interface MenuItem ' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -45; echo "---- AsideHeaderItem"; grep -rn 'AsideHeaderItem\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -5; echo "---- LOGO"; grep -rn -A14 'export interface LogoProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/ | head -30

grep -n -B3 -A3 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head -40; echo "---- SIZE"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/types.d.ts; echo "---- SWITCH"; grep -n -E 'onUpdate|checked|content|size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -rn 'onUpdate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/

grep -n 'ColumnDef\|types/base' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; sed -i "s#import type {ColumnDef, ExpandedState, Row, RowSelectionState, SortingState} from '@gravity-ui/table/tanstack';#import type {ColumnDef, ColumnReorderingProviderProps} from '@gravity-ui/table';\nimport type {ExpandedState, Row, RowSelectionState, SortingState} from '@gravity-ui/table/tanstack';#; /^import type {ColumnReorderingProviderProps} from '@gravity-ui\/table';$/d" src/orders/OrdersTable.tsx && sed -n 1,20p src/orders/OrdersTable.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20

echo "---- GROUP HEADER DEFAULT"; grep -rn -B2 -A6 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js | head -40; echo "---- sp"; grep -n 'sp\b\|spacing' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/spacing/spacing.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---- CONTENT CSS"; grep -n -A6 '__content\b\|__content {' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/*.css

echo "---- getRowContent group default"; grep -n -B2 -A8 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -40; echo "---- CONTENT CSS"; grep -n -o -E '\.gn-aside-header__(content|pane-container|content-wrapper)[^{]*\{[^}]*\}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -10; grep -n -o -E '\.gn-aside-header\{[^}]*\}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -3

echo "---- group header render"; sed -n 30,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js; echo "---- Table.js defaults"; grep -n 'getIsGroupHeaderRow\|getGroupTitle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js | head; echo "---- ASIDE CSS"; tr '}' '}\n' < node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | grep -E 'content|100vh|height:100%|min-height' | head -15; grep -n 'height' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -5
